40527149.study_design: international AI challenge/benchmark study using multi-country low-resource ultrasound data

40528866.clinical_problem: understanding factors that influence pediatric emergency physicians' trust in AI-augmented point-of-care ultrasound (image acquisition, interpretation, workflow)
40528866.model_description: Qualitative interview study (not developing a specific AI model) exploring pediatric emergency physicians' perceptions of and trust in AI-augmented point-of-care ultrasound for image acquisition, interpretation and workflow support.
40528866.study_design: qualitative semistructured interview study using template analysis

40547555.exclusion_reason: gastrointestinal endoscopy review of foreign body removal; non-radiologic endoscopic imaging, AI mentioned only in passing

40572641.clinical_problem: comprehensive review of AI applications across pediatric orthopedic subspecialties: spinal deformity classification, hip dysplasia diagnosis, fracture detection, bone age estimation, and limb-length discrepancy
40572641.patient_population: pediatric orthopedic patients across reviewed studies
40572641.model_description: Narrative review of AI/ML models (SVM, CNN, YOLO-based object detectors, ResNet classifiers) applied to pediatric orthopedic imaging tasks including spinal curve classification, DDH radiographic diagnosis, fracture detection, and bone age estimation.
40572641.headline_result: >90% accuracy achieved by SVM/CNN models for spinal deformity classification and curve prediction (across reviewed studies)

40619593.clinical_problem: real-time detection of the standard imaging plane during hip ultrasound (Graf method) for developmental dysplasia of the hip screening, to reduce operator-dependent variability
40619593.patient_population: 2,737 annotated frames from 45 clinical ultrasound videos (training) plus 934 frames independent validation set
40619593.model_description: AI-SPS uses object-detection models (SSD-MobileNet V2 and YOLOv11n) to take real-time hip ultrasound video frames as input and classify/localize the standard diagnostic plane for DDH screening (Graf method) as output.
40619593.dataset_size: 2,737 training frames + 934 validation frames (45 clinical videos)
40619593.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

40634883.model_family: CNN (DeepLabV3 ResNet segmentation + radiomics/deep transfer learning feature fusion model)
40634883.clinical_problem: automated quality assessment and segmentation of first-trimester ultrasound images for accurate fetal nuchal translucency measurement, to improve screening for chromosomal abnormalities
40634883.patient_population: 2,140 ultrasound images of fetal face midsagittal sections, 11-14 weeks gestation
40634883.model_description: A DeepLabV3-ResNet segmentation model outputs the region of interest on midsagittal fetal face ultrasound images; radiomics and deep transfer learning features are then extracted and fused in a model that outputs a quality classification for nuchal translucency measurement images, benchmarked against junior radiologists, with SHAP interpretability analysis.
40634883.headline_result: Segmentation DSC 98.07%; feature-fusion quality-assessment model AUC 0.978, accuracy 93.2%
40634883.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study, compared against junior radiologists

40683831.body_region: whole body (oncologic FDG PET, various tumor types including pediatric)
40683831.clinical_problem: reviewing AI applications (radiomics, machine learning, deep learning) in FDG PET/CT oncologic imaging across tumor types, including a section on pediatric oncology
40683831.patient_population: oncology patients undergoing FDG PET/CT (review of literature); pediatric oncology as a subset
40683831.model_description: Narrative review (Part II of a series) of AI-driven radiomics and machine-learning approaches applied to FDG PET/CT imaging across malignancies (hematologic, genitourinary, melanoma, CNS, and pediatric oncology), covering lesion segmentation, treatment-response prediction, and survival-outcome modeling.
40683831.study_design: narrative review (Part II of a series)

40710610.model_family: machine learning (SVM, Random Forest, Multilayer Perceptron; Random Forest best-performing)
40710610.clinical_problem: classifying transverse fetal head position during labor from intrapartum ultrasound geometric parameters to predict delivery outcome and guide management
40710610.patient_population: 66 cases of transverse fetal head position from 135 nulliparous women with prolonged second-stage labor, 3 Italian hospitals
40710610.model_description: AIDA takes four geometric parameters (Angle of Progression, Head-Symphysis Distance, Midline Angle, Asynclitism Degree) measured on intrapartum ultrasound as input to machine-learning algorithms (Random Forest performed best) and outputs classification of labor dystocia severity class, predicting likelihood of cesarean versus vaginal delivery.
40710610.headline_result: Random Forest achieved 95.5% overall accuracy predicting delivery outcome
40710610.study_design: retrospective secondary analysis of a multicenter cohort study

40724686.exclusion_reason: health-economics cost-consequence analysis across cardiology, obstetrics and gastroenterology AI systems (HosmartAI project); not specific to pediatric radiology imaging

40773751.clinical_problem: identifying second-trimester fetal ultrasound findings suspicious for major congenital heart defects using AI-based software, to improve antenatal CHD detection
40773751.patient_population: 877 examinations from 11 centers, second-trimester fetal ultrasounds
40773751.model_description: AI-based software analyzes grayscale 2D ultrasound cine clips from second-trimester fetal echocardiographic examinations as input and outputs presence/absence/inconclusive labels for eight morphologic findings associated with severe congenital heart defects.
40773751.headline_result: Sensitivity 0.968 for severe CHD; sensitivity 0.987, specificity 0.977 for detecting any suspicious finding vs fetal cardiologists

40853542.clinical_problem: synthesizing molecular, clinical and imaging (MRI) correlations in pediatric-type high-grade diffuse gliomas, including emerging AI/radiomics approaches to imaging biomarkers
40853542.patient_population: children with pediatric-type high-grade diffuse glioma (literature review)
40853542.model_description: Narrative review of radiological-molecular correlations in pediatric-type high-grade diffuse gliomas (diffuse midline glioma H3 K27-altered, diffuse hemispheric glioma H3 G34-mutant, H3/IDH-wildtype glioma, infant-type hemispheric glioma), highlighting emerging AI-based radiomics and deep-learning approaches for imaging biomarkers of molecular subtype.

40957986.exclusion_reason: broad review of AI across pediatric nephrology (genomics, EHR, chatbots, dialysis dosing, documentation); imaging (ultrasound) is only briefly mentioned as one of many applications, not primarily a radiology AI review

40959708.clinical_problem: predicting future depression and anxiety severity in children and adolescents from baseline resting-state brain functional connectivity
40959708.patient_population: ABCD cohort n=3,718 children (9-11y) + BANDA n=150 adolescents (14-17y)
40959708.model_description: Connectome-based predictive modeling uses baseline whole-brain resting-state functional connectivity MRI as input to predict depression and anxiety symptom severity at 1-year follow-up as output, validated internally in a childhood cohort (ABCD) and externally in an adolescent cohort (BANDA).
40959708.headline_result: ABCD internal: rho=0.058, p=0.040; BANDA external validation: rho=0.222, p=0.007
40959708.study_design: prospective longitudinal cohort study with internal and external validation of a connectome-based predictive model

41006992.clinical_problem: reviewing AI applications in pediatric neuroradiology including accelerated image acquisition/reconstruction, and lesion detection (e.g., MELD algorithm for focal cortical dysplasia in epilepsy)
41006992.model_description: Narrative review of AI in pediatric neuroradiology covering accelerated MRI/CT acquisition (compressed sensing, undersampling) and reconstruction (denoising, super-resolution), and lesion-detection tools such as the MELD algorithm, which compares a patient's MRI to a reference database to detect focal cortical dysplasias in epilepsy.

41043137.exclusion_reason: systematic review of AI predicting NICU clinical outcomes and length of stay; predominantly clinical/physiological data-driven, imaging only briefly mentioned as one of several application areas

41100866.clinical_problem: evaluating whether AI-based software improves ob-gyn and maternal-fetal medicine specialists' identification of second-trimester fetal ultrasound findings suspicious for congenital heart defects
41100866.patient_population: 200 fetal ultrasound examinations from 11 centers, singleton pregnancies 18-24 weeks gestation
41100866.model_description: AI-based software analyzes 2D grayscale fetal cardiac ultrasound cine clips (four-chamber, LVOT, RVOT views) and assists ob-gyn/MFM readers in identifying eight findings suspicious for congenital heart defects, with reader performance compared with and without AI assistance.
41100866.headline_result: AI-aided AUROC 0.974 vs unaided 0.825 (P=.002); sensitivity 0.935 vs 0.782

41145423.model_family: CNN (multi-view, pretrained on adult CXR then fine-tuned)
41145423.clinical_problem: detecting pediatric pulmonary tuberculosis-compatible chest X-ray findings, especially in low-resource high-prevalence settings, to improve pediatric TB diagnosis
41145423.patient_population: 918 pediatric CXRs from three pediatric TB cohorts (external test), pretrained on 114,173 adult CXRs
41145423.model_description: pTBLightNet is a multi-view deep-learning framework that takes frontal and lateral chest X-ray images as input, pretrained on adult CXR data and fine-tuned on pediatric data, and outputs a classification of TB-compatible versus non-TB-compatible pediatric chest radiographs.
41145423.dataset_size: 918 pediatric CXRs (3 cohorts) + 114,173 adult CXRs for pretraining
41145423.study_design: retrospective multi-cohort deep learning model development and external validation study

41180134.clinical_problem: reviewing radiomics approaches predicting sensitivity to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in osteosarcoma, a tumor predominantly affecting adolescents
41180134.model_description: Systematic review of radiomics-based machine-learning approaches that extract quantitative features from CT, MRI, and FDG PET/CT images of osteosarcoma to predict response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

41209653.exclusion_reason: systematic review of epilepsy prediction models in children primarily based on clinical features and EEG; MRI-based models are a minor comparator, not primarily a pediatric radiology AI review

41236810.clinical_problem: examining how multimodal brain MRI (alongside genetics and environment) explains the relationship between children's cognitive abilities and mental health
41236810.model_description: Multivariate predictive models use 45 MRI-derived features (task/resting-state fMRI, structural MRI, diffusion imaging) together with polygenic scores and environmental factors as input to predict children's cognitive abilities and to quantify how much of the cognitive-mental-health relationship each data type explains.
41236810.headline_result: Neuroimaging predicted cognitive abilities r=0.54; explained 66% of the cognitive-mental health link
41236810.study_design: cross-sectional and 2-year longitudinal multivariate modeling study (ABCD cohort)

41238791.clinical_problem: fully automated reporting of fetal brain biometric measurements (13 linear measurements) from 3D T2-weighted MRI with z-scores/centiles versus normative growth charts, to standardize and speed clinical reporting
41238791.patient_population: 90 retrospective cases (quantitative evaluation) + 111 prospective cases (wide GA range) + 406 normal control datasets for centile charts
41238791.model_description: A deep-learning pipeline (3D U-Net-based anatomical landmark localization) takes 3-D reconstructed T2-weighted fetal brain MRI as input and outputs 13 automated linear biometric measurements, associated z-scores/centiles versus normative growth charts, and an automated .html report.
41238791.dataset_size: 90 retrospective + 111 prospective cases; 406 normal controls for centile charts
41238791.headline_result: Max absolute difference vs manual measurement 1-3 mm; >98% of landmark placements acceptable in prospective evaluation; processing under 5 min/case
41238791.study_design: retrospective quantitative validation plus prospective end-to-end pipeline evaluation

41296871.exclusion_reason: wearable pressure-strain sensor system for fetal movement monitoring; not an imaging-based AI model (ultrasound used only for validation reference, not as model input)

37053059.exclusion_reason: predicts infant cognitive development risk from video recordings of general movements; not a radiologic imaging modality

38118183.exclusion_reason: review of intrapartum fetal monitoring technologies (cardiotocography, biochemical sampling, Doppler ultrasound monitoring signals); not primarily a radiologic imaging AI review

38182986.clinical_problem: differentiating Wilms tumor from clear cell sarcoma of the kidney in children using CT radiomics, to guide pre-surgical diagnosis
38182986.patient_population: 83 Wilms tumor and 33 clear cell sarcoma cases in children
38182986.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from corticomedullary-phase CT images of pediatric renal tumors are combined into a logistic regression model that outputs the probability of Wilms tumor versus clear cell sarcoma of the kidney.
38182986.headline_result: AUC 0.889 training, 0.792 test set; accuracy 0.864 training, 0.857 test
38182986.study_design: retrospective single/primary-cohort study with internal train/test split and cross-validation

38205381.exclusion_reason: methodological ultrasound localization microscopy technique paper; demonstrated on a neonatal pig (animal model), not a human pediatric patient population

38266752.model_name: HR-IQS (fetal Heart Rhythm Intelligent Quantification System)
38266752.clinical_problem: automated extraction of fetal cardiac time intervals from pulsed-wave Doppler ultrasound spectra to establish normal reference ranges and assist diagnosis of fetal arrhythmia
38266752.patient_population: 6,498 PWD spectra from 2,630 fetuses across 14 centers
38266752.model_description: HR-IQS is a deep-learning model that takes pulsed-wave Doppler ultrasound spectra of the fetal heart as input and automatically extracts 17 cardiac time intervals (E, A, V wave timings), benchmarked against manual expert labeling, used to establish normal reference ranges.
38266752.headline_result: Significant positive correlation and moderate-to-excellent consistency (ICC) between manual and automated CTI measurements (P<.001)
38266752.study_design: multicenter prospective study with deep learning model development (five-fold cross-validation)

38283829.clinical_problem: predicting future risk of pulmonary arterial hypertension in children with ventricular septal defect using standard chest radiographs
38283829.model_description: A ResNet-based convolutional neural network takes standard chest radiographs from children with ventricular septal defect as input and outputs a prediction of future pulmonary arterial hypertension risk, with Class Activation Mapping highlighting the pulmonary artery segment as the model's attention region.
38283829.headline_result: AUC 0.82 validation, 0.81 independent test set (vs 0.65 for human observers)
38283829.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

38294541.exclusion_reason: adult chronic hepatitis B patients; no pediatric population

38431181.clinical_problem: joint automated brain extraction and image quality assessment of fetal brain MRI slices to support 3D reconstruction and quantification
38431181.patient_population: fetal brain MRI dataset of varying image quality (size not specified numerically)
38431181.model_description: A two-stage dual-task deep-learning framework (with transformer-based feature extraction) takes fetal brain MRI slices as input and jointly outputs a brain extraction (segmentation) mask and an image-quality-assessment score, validated via five-fold cross-validation and cross-dataset testing.
38431181.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study with five-fold cross-validation and cross-dataset validation

38534491.exclusion_reason: overview of reviews on mobile/domiciliary radiology (telemedicine, mobile mammography, home X-ray); AI in pediatric radiology mentioned as one highlighted finding but not the review's focus

38537766.model_family: graph convolutional network (GCN) with supervised contrastive learning (SCL)
38537766.clinical_problem: early prediction of neurodevelopmental deficits (cognition, language, motor) at 2 years corrected age in very preterm infants using brain structural connectome from MRI at term-equivalent age
38537766.patient_population: ~280 very preterm infants (CINEPS cohort), MRI at term-equivalent age
38537766.model_description: A graph convolutional network trained with supervised contrastive learning takes the brain structural connectome (derived from diffusion MRI at term-equivalent age) as a graph input and outputs predicted risk of neurodevelopmental deficits (cognitive, language, motor) at 2 years corrected age in very preterm infants.
38537766.headline_result: Mean AUCs 0.72-0.75 for predicting three neurodevelopmental deficits
38537766.study_design: prospective single-cohort study with deep learning model development

38548336.model_family: machine learning (unspecified algorithms; general linear models + ML)
38548336.clinical_problem: predicting individual children's behavioral response to transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) from neuroanatomical MRI measures (cortical thickness, surface area), to inform future personalized neuromodulation treatment in neurodevelopmental disorders
38548336.patient_population: 57 typically developing male and female children who received tDCS
38548336.model_description: Machine-learning algorithms use structural MRI-derived cortical thickness and surface area measures as input to predict individual children's task-performance response to transcranial direct current stimulation as output.
38548336.headline_result: Highest ML accuracy: 65% of behavioral variance in N-back task performance explained by surface area (DLPFCleft stimulation)
38548336.study_design: prospective experimental (sham-controlled) study with machine learning model development

38555414.clinical_problem: building pediatric-specific pretrained radiograph models to improve downstream pediatric radiology AI tasks such as fracture classification and bone age assessment, addressing the mismatch of natural-image pretrained models for grayscale medical images
38555414.patient_population: ~70,000 pediatric X-ray images collected over 24 years at Asan Medical Center
38555414.model_description: PedXnets are Inception V3-based models pretrained on ~70,000 pediatric radiographs classified by radiographic view (7, 30, or 68 classes) to serve as domain-specific backbones for transfer learning; validated on downstream tasks of pediatric fracture classification and bone age assessment.
38555414.dataset_size: ~70,000 pediatric X-ray images (24 years, single center)
38555414.study_design: retrospective single-center pretraining and transfer-learning validation study

38570368.clinical_problem: automated measurement of total cardiac volume from CT for donor-recipient heart-size matching in pediatric heart transplantation
38570368.patient_population: 270 training + 44 validation subjects (36 normal, 8 heart disease), ages 0-30 years
38570368.model_description: A custom 3D convolutional neural network (DenseNet architecture combined with ResNet residual blocks) takes chest CT scans as input and outputs an automated segmentation and calculation of total cardiac volume, for use in pediatric heart-transplant donor-recipient size matching.
38570368.headline_result: Dice similarity coefficient 0.94 ± 0.03; mean absolute percent error 5.5% for TCV estimation
38570368.study_design: retrospective single-center deep learning model development and validation study

38575952.exclusion_reason: protocol for a randomized controlled trial of music/visual arts training effects on child cognitive and brain development; imaging modality not specified, and machine learning used only as an analysis method

38596101.clinical_problem: using fetal brain functional connectivity from resting-state fMRI combined with maternal risk factors to improve prediction of preterm birth risk
38596101.patient_population: 31 singleton pregnancies, 28-34 weeks gestation (19 low-risk, 12 high-risk for preterm birth)
38596101.model_description: A random forest model (MaFra-Neuro) combines the Maternal Frailty Inventory score with fetal brain functional connectivity features derived from resting-state fMRI (estimated using the Greedy Equivalence Search algorithm) as input to predict preterm birth risk, gestational age at birth, and related perinatal outcomes.
